name: AmTrust Financial Services, Inc.
summary: AmTrust Financial Services, Inc., established in 1998 and headquartered in New York, NY, operates as a provider of property and casualty insurance. The company underwrites a comprehensive range of policies, encompassing automobile, commercial auto liability, general liability, products liability, marine, inland marine, various multi-peril coverages (including the liability segment of commercial multiple peril policies), and workers' compensation, alongside other property and casualty offerings.
